🇮🇷 Mojtaba Khamenei has urged the Basij, a volunteer force linked to the Revolutionary Guards, to expand their social influence and aim to make every Iranian a member. Since the war initiated by the United States and Israel in February, the Basij have been instrumental in organising pro-government rallies. Khamenei communicated his message through written statements during Basij Week, calling for the Basij to engage a broader base of supporters, including those who share their ideology but are not formal members, to tackle national issues. Khamenei’s appeal comes amid economic challenges and US sanctions, which aim to pressure the government and exploit public discontent. The government is also mobilising support through initiatives like the Janfada programme and a Basij energy campaign to encourage reduced electricity and gas consumption amid potential winter energy shortages .

The fulfillment of prophecies about the Apocalypse seems closer than ever amid the development of artificial intelligence technologies, Patriarch of Moscow and All Russia Kirill said. "Others fear that, having concentrated control over all life-support processes in its hands through an army of robots, artificial intelligence might decide that humans are actually a redundant link in this production chain. What fate then awaits humanity?" he said at the plenary session of the 28th World Russian People's Council. Some people already perceive AI advice as objective truth, the Patriarch stressed. He questioned whether the prospect of development at the cost of losing the ability to make independent decisions could benefit humanity.

Reporters Without Borders demands suspension of controversial French TV channel CNews Paris-based international press freedom group Reporters Without Borders (RSF) on Thursday called on France's media regulator Arcom to suspend right-wing channel CNews for one month over its failure to uphold pluralism.
